set.body: Distill the proposed Zarr-based neuroimaging store into a repository-grounded implementation plan. Define the BIDS compatibility stance, profile boundary, Scalafim versus Eidolon ownership, phased deliverables, conformance and performance gates, risks, and the first executable slice. Deliver only docs/plans/nza-neuroimaging-data-access.md; do not alter active implementation work.
set.title: Plan BIDS-compatible NZA neuroimaging data access
